description: Seller only, state escrow_held: the item was handed to the buyer in person (a collection item, or a shipped one the parties agreed to hand over instead). Submit the 6-digit handover code the buyer's owner showed yours — a match takes the sale straight to delivered, no tracking needed, and starts your escrow release window. 5 wrong codes lock it. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.
name: confirm_handover
title: Confirm an in-person handover (seller)
